target: Saudi-market founder or owner whose first intended core software functionality remains unbuilt, with affirmative evidence of a maximum of two current software builders and a specific project to build. A completed but private product does not qualify simply because it has not launched.
main_findings: The existing resource set prioritizes discoverable startups with funding, launched products and demo-day coverage. Those signals often indicate the opposite of the revised persona.
Acquire candidates at program admission and idea-validation stages. Alumni success stories and showcase winners are useful for disqualification checks but are usually late discovery points.

Split umbrella brands into specific programs and editions. The Garage incubator and accelerator have different stages; Sanabil Startup Unlocked differs from Sanabil Accelerator; StartSmart 9th and 10th editions have materially different eligibility.

Misk Launchpad 10.0 lists a September 6, 2026 start and an initial Ideate phase, making current admission announcements a timely source to inspect. Attendance alone does not establish team size, budget or a paid build requirement.

A zero-person LinkedIn people result is not evidence that a company has zero developers. Visible people are a lower bound unless a current, sufficiently complete team statement establishes an upper bound.

A technical co-founder counts as one software builder, not an automatic exclusion. An equity-only co-founder request is a founder-hiring signal and must not be promoted to explicit paid-vendor demand.
The absence of an app-store listing is not evidence of a pre-build company; web applications, private deployments, contractors and white-label products must be checked.
Do not transfer the v1 accepted-lead yields into v2. Recompute all yield figures against the revised gates and retain a versioned denominator.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Idea, prototype, MVP or early launch; Saudi-market commitment; solo founders eligible; initial Ideate phase followed by Build and Test to Sell.
first_party_verifications.timing: 10.0 page lists September 6, 2026 to January 2, 2027; application window June 15 to August 8, 2026.
first_party_verifications.limitation: The page also calls the core experience 10 weeks. Record the listed dates rather than infer a consistent duration. Public testimonials include mature alumni, so do not use them as evidence of current pre-build status.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Incubator: prototype or MVP, support toward launch. Accelerator: completed product, growth and expansion. Hosted programs include MVP Lab and Antler.
first_party_verifications.limitation: The incubator still admits already-developed MVPs; every candidate requires product and team checks. Program listings do not constitute a public participant roster.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Technology startups with an MVP and early traction looking to scale in MENA.
first_party_verifications.limitation: The current page contains inconsistent dates and template placeholders. Use its explicit stage criteria, not uncertain scheduling or fee fragments. This program is a poor primary fit for pre-build acquisition.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Official 500 MENA post describes a five-day Riyadh bootcamp for idea or MVP founders and companies expanding into Saudi Arabia.
first_party_verifications.timing: This post advertised February 8–12, 2026, not an upcoming event.
first_party_verifications.limitation: Some participants may already operate products elsewhere. The post proves a relevant program format, not current availability, a complete participant list or buying readiness.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Ninth edition: AI-driven ideas, MVPs and pre-seed startups; FAQ describes 40 idea-stage and pre-MVP teams; Saudi-based idea and at least one Saudi team member.
first_party_verifications.limitation: Historical cohort from late 2025/early 2026; page contains conflicting closing dates. Its stage criteria must not be attributed to future editions. Historical participation alone is stale product evidence.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Tenth edition, titled Competition 2027: existing startups with at least SAR 5,000 revenue; idea-only applicants explicitly ineligible. Tracks cover health, environment, social entrepreneurship and industry.
first_party_verifications.funding_caveat: Prizes are technical subscriptions and credits, not cash paid to the winners.
first_party_verifications.limitation: Revenue can come from a manual service, so this is not an automatic exclusion; it is a weak source for pure idea-stage founders. Verify the exact product and revenue basis.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Historical Thakaa digitization workshop teaches digital transformation strategy, project management and technology use for entrepreneurship.
first_party_verifications.timing: Event date August 9, 2023; the page links a broader events listing.
first_party_verifications.limitation: This proves a channel type, not a current cohort or an actionable buyer roster. General workshop attendance does not establish a bespoke software project.

Official Garage page links this URL as MVP Lab. Eligibility, provider arrangement and grant conditions require a fresh readable first-party source before accepting claims; this review did not verify them.

first_party_verifications.official_stage_eligibility: Solo founders and early teams validating ideas or building first products; Riyadh fall residency includes team formation. Separate investment route accepts more established teams.
first_party_verifications.limitation: Residency seeks co-founder formation and may provide delivery capacity. Investment is conditional; participation does not prove available budget or demand for outsourcing. Use resident introductions rather than portfolio companies.

resource_revisions.rationale: Current official program accepts the desired early stage, but the old extraction method focused too much on mature testimonials.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Inspect public 10.0 admission and Ideate participant posts; extract only named founders with a specific unbuilt software concept. Capture admission date, product stage statement and full source URL, then audit team and vendor demand. Recheck at transition into Build.
resource_revisions.cadence: weekly during admission and Ideate; every two weeks through Build
resource_revisions.limitation: No public list is guaranteed. Do not treat program membership or free enrollment as budget evidence.

resource_revisions.rationale: Useful public participant discovery surface; avoid counting the same Misk cohort as two independent sources.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Read current official Ideate/Build cohort posts and founders' own statements. Ignore congratulations, likes and follower lists; attribute discovery to Misk plus this access channel.
resource_revisions.limitation: Program site and its LinkedIn account are one underlying organization, not independent corroboration.

resource_revisions.rationale: The official incubator supports prototype/MVP toward launch, while the accelerator explicitly requires a completed product.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Create child sources for incubator admissions, idea workshops, MVP Lab and accelerator. Extract named prototype teams only from the first three; use accelerator membership as a product-maturity check.
resource_revisions.limitation: Prototype/MVP labels need candidate-specific interpretation; a live MVP fails the user's first-product constraint.

resource_revisions.rationale: MVP Lab is a promising child channel; an umbrella of financing, growth and unicorn products is too broad.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Verify current MVP Lab rules and public beneficiaries. For a named candidate, establish that the build remains uncontracted and distinguish cash support from provider-delivered services or cloud credits.
resource_revisions.limitation: Current eligibility and budget terms were not readable in this review. Never assume a grant is available to hire the user's business.

resource_revisions.rationale: MVP plus early traction is required; growth acceleration is poorly aligned with pre-build demand.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Use the cohort/company page to establish product maturity and exclude an already-launched core product. Pursue a candidate only if fresh, specific evidence establishes an eligible unbuilt product and very small team.
resource_revisions.limitation: MENA location alone does not establish Saudi operations.

resource_revisions.rationale: Official Startup Unlocked messaging includes idea-stage founders, unlike the seed accelerator.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Inspect the next publicly announced Startup Unlocked intake and named participant introductions. Record the exact program name and cohort; investigate pre-MVP entrants before bootcamp completion.
resource_revisions.limitation: The verified February 2026 event is past; no future date is asserted. Existing companies expanding into Saudi must be filtered out if their core product already operates.

resource_revisions.rationale: The 9th edition accepted idea/pre-MVP projects. The currently promoted 10th edition excludes idea-only teams and requires revenue.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Keep the 9th-edition roster as a historical discovery queue and recheck every product today. Create a separate 10th-edition source; shortlist manual-service businesses only if the first core software product remains unbuilt.
resource_revisions.cadence: one historical revalidation pass; then per new edition
resource_revisions.limitation: The 10th-edition technical credits are not vendor cash. Do not carry the earlier edition's grants or stage assumptions into the new cohort.

resource_revisions.rationale: Generic launching/platform/AI terms find completed products. Explicit current first-person build requests are closer to this persona.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Run small read-only recent-post searches for exact phrases such as looking for an app development company, MVP development partner, developing our first app, seeking a technical cofounder, أبحث عن شركة برمجة, تطوير تطبيق لمشروعي, نبحث عن شريك تقني, and نعمل على نموذج أولي, then apply Saudi geography terms. Tag paid vendor request, employee vacancy, equity-only co-founder request, or unclear separately; exact-name verification follows discovery.
resource_revisions.limitation: These are proposed search phrases, not verified buyer posts. Cofounder or employee searches establish a possible capacity gap but not paid-vendor demand; public post visibility and commercial limits may constrain coverage.

resource_revisions.rationale: The SME lane needs owner statements and unbuilt workflow projects, not generic accelerator directories or solution providers.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Use current SME Support Centre, Thakaa and sector-event pages to find public named owner cases; follow the business's own description of manual workflow and planned first system. Reject provider catalogues as buyer evidence.
resource_revisions.limitation: The verified workshop is historical and supplies no live buyer roster. General digital transformation interest often means off-the-shelf software adoption, not custom development.

resource_revisions.rationale: Current stored evidence establishes seed support, not pre-build eligibility or small software teams.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Before any new harvest, confirm current intake criteria; use individual company pages to check already-launched products. Do not accept a seed label as pre-build evidence.
resource_revisions.limitation: Not refreshed online in this review.

resource_revisions.rationale: Stored demo-day evidence describes companies after months developing products; it tends to surface candidates late for a first build.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Use product descriptions and company links to resolve maturity; seek admissions instead if a pre-build intake is later documented.
resource_revisions.limitation: Not refreshed online in this review.

resource_revisions.rationale: Potentially useful at entry, but grant and accelerator status do not establish an unbuilt product or a delivery gap.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Verify current admission criteria and isolate incoming teams with explicit first-product plans. Confirm grant award and allowable spending candidate by candidate.
resource_revisions.limitation: Not refreshed online in this review; no current pre-build eligibility asserted.

resource_revisions.rationale: The stored showcase describes finalists preparing to scale, so use it after discovery to verify maturity and financing.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Cross-check named candidates against completed products and current operations; do not use prize winners as default primary acquisition.
resource_revisions.limitation: Not refreshed online in this review.

resource_revisions.rationale: A 2024 accelerator report cannot prove current intent; current idea challenges may be a better channel if named entrants are public.
resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Locate a current official challenge with explicit idea/prototype entry criteria before harvesting; confirm entrants are buyers rather than software vendors.
resource_revisions.limitation: No specific current challenge verified here.

grouped_resource_revisions.rationale: Funding and launch news selects visible operating companies and cannot compensate for a failed pre-build or team gate.
grouped_resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Search only an already-discovered exact venture to verify financing, existing product, named founders and stage; label source role as corroboration or exclusion. Any new seed requires independent pre-build evidence.
grouped_resource_revisions.limitation: Class-level strategy recommendation based on the stored source definitions, not a fresh audit of each website.

grouped_resource_revisions.rationale: Public exhibitors and finalists commonly have products; event location does not establish a Saudi-market venture.
grouped_resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Require an explicitly documented idea/pre-launch track and named participants before harvesting. For SME owners, require an owner-described first-software project; discard technology suppliers selling products.
grouped_resource_revisions.limitation: No current idea-track eligibility verified in this review; do not assume one exists.

grouped_resource_revisions.rationale: Founder introductions may expose pre-build projects, but an event/catalogue alone gives no team maximum, budget or stage guarantee.
grouped_resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Time-box a current named-founder pass; retain only explicit unbuilt concepts; record reviewed and accepted counts before giving the channel more time.
grouped_resource_revisions.limitation: Not refreshed online here. Project Startup's stored evidence is from 2025.

grouped_resource_revisions.rationale: General Saudi app and funding coverage is predominantly maturity verification, with occasional pre-launch exceptions.
grouped_resource_revisions.extraction_recipe: Use exact-venture lookup; only first-product plans enter the discovery queue.
grouped_resource_revisions.limitation: Publisher praise and engagement do not prove buying demand.

missing_channels.extraction_recipe: Inspect public Riyadh residency admissions and founder introductions at the start of the program; record a named pre-product concept, existing software builders and stated delivery preference. Exclude portfolio success stories from the acquisition pass.
missing_channels.limitations: Many founders seek an equity co-founder or build internally; paid vendor intent must be separately established.

missing_channels.extraction_recipe: Search public first-person posts by Saudi owners describing a specific manual workflow and intended first app or internal system. Use business website and owner role to verify authority and operations; record software alternative fit and any explicit budget evidence.
missing_channels.limitations: Channel hypothesis, not a verified source list. WhatsApp, spreadsheets or an old website alone do not prove intent or a need for custom software.

missing_channels.extraction_recipe: Find current official pre-incubation/idea-validation competition rosters with named adult project founders; validate ownership, continuation beyond coursework and a specific first-product plan. Avoid generic hackathon attendance lists.
missing_channels.limitations: No current named program verified here. Student prototypes commonly lack budget, authority or plans for commercial continuation. A team of technical students may already exceed the software-person limit.

missing_channels.extraction_recipe: Search public requests for software agencies, freelance MVP development or a scoped first app. Capture project timing, whether compensation is cash/equity/unknown, and buyer identity when public; verify Saudi relevance without collecting contact details.
missing_channels.limitations: Do not imply anonymous briefs are named verified leads. Public availability and provider competition may reduce usable yield. No accounts, submissions or outreach are required for the research pass.

new_fields: product_delivery_state: idea | design | manual_pilot | no_code_prototype | private_alpha | launched | unknown
delivery_arrangement: founder_building | in_house | contractor | agency | none_confirmed | unknown
buyer_request_type: paid_vendor | employee | equity_cofounder | mixed | unclear
budget_evidence_type: project_cash | paid_pilot | cash_grant | general_funding | cloud_credits | unknown
evidence_and_funnel_enhancements.qualification_rule: Active accepted requires affirmative evidence that intended core functionality remains unbuilt and a supported software-team maximum of two. Partial public observation of 0–2 software people remains a research candidate; it is not a confirmed maximum. A single technical founder is allowed. Unknown paid buying intent limits priority even when persona fit passes.
evidence_and_funnel_enhancements.allocation_note: Starting experiment, not an evidence-backed optimal split. Reallocate after the first comparable reviewed batches.
evidence_and_funnel_enhancements.stop_rule: Use reviewed-candidate yield and research cost. A source with no accepted leads after two separate 15-candidate reviewed batches should be demoted, while its unresolved count and dominant gap are reported; avoid stopping promising channels merely because public team evidence is slow to resolve.
evidence_and_funnel_enhancements.refresh: Recheck intent and team before acceptance; re-review active pre-launch candidates after 30 days because launch/team state can change quickly. Recheck program rules every edition.

future_source_metrics.attribution: Use unique candidate/project IDs; credit first discovery to a single source and track assisting verification sources separately. Official website and official social feed belong to one source family.

metrics.name: qualified_yield_per_reviewed
metrics.numerator: unique candidates accepted under the revised persona after completed review
metrics.denominator: unique candidates whose persona review was completed for this source and batch

metrics.name: research_minutes_per_accepted
metrics.numerator: all discovery and review minutes spent on this source batch, including rejected and held candidates
metrics.denominator: unique accepted candidates first discovered by this source

metrics.name: unresolved_team_share
metrics.numerator: reviewed candidates held because team maximum is unknown

metrics.name: already_launched_share
metrics.numerator: reviewed candidates excluded because the core product is launched

metrics.name: explicit_paid_demand_share
metrics.numerator: accepted candidates with an explicit current paid external-vendor request; project budget alone is insufficient

metrics.name: explicit_build_budget_share
metrics.numerator: accepted candidates with an explicit cash allocation for the intended build

future_source_metrics.reason_observed_values_null: This task reviewed source strategy rather than running a new v2 lead acquisition batch. Existing v1 accepted counts are not valid v2 yields.
